latest.title: Nvidia is done with Jensen Huang. The fallout in Washington is just beginning
latest.description: The Republican-led Congress wants to see Jensen Huang in Washington before Democrats take control in January.

latest.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has deep ties to the chipmaker
latest.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

latest.title: Bitcoin miners pay Paraguay $350 million a year, but AI is pushing them out
latest.description: Contracts that sell power to a 4% slice of the world’s bitcoin mining at $44 a megawatt-hour expire on Dec. 31, 2027. Paraguay’s state utility calls the date final, and it has just signed a 15-year deal to power a Founders Fund-backed AI campus.

latest.title: Nvidia stock suffers longest weekly losing streak since 2012 as market value sinks by $1.7 trillion
latest.description: Jensen Huang's resignation added to Nvidia's market woes, with the stock already in a downward slide since early October.

latest.title: Could a Former Nvidia Executive Replace Jensen Huang? Arm’s Rene Haas Emerges as Candidate
latest.description: Nvidia's board has reportedly approached Arm's chief executive as it searches for a replacement for Jensen Huang, while some employees are pushing to bring the chipmaker's founder back as CEO.

latest.description: Blockstream’s new custody system, developed with Thales, uses dedicated hardware for transaction signing as Adam Back advocates for offline security to reduce cyber risks.
